item.title: Ajman Police honour girl for returning lost money she found
item.description: Ajman Police recognised a young girl for her honesty after she surrendered money she found in a public place, praising her as a role model for the youth

item.title: UAE rulers pardon 6,170 prisoners ahead of 54th Eid Al Etihad
item.description: A total of 6,170 prisoners were pardoned across the UAE ahead of Eid Al Etihad, with rulers ordering releases and settling financial penalties

item.title: Trump vows to ‘permanently pause’ migration from 'Third World' countries
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced plans to halt migration from “Third World Countries” following a shooting involving an Afghan national near the White House

item.title: Over 8,000 delivery riders fined in Dubai for using fast lanes
item.description: Dubai Police fined more than 8,000 delivery riders in the first weeks of enforcing a ban on using fast lanes. Officials say the rule aims to reduce accidents

item.title: Hong Kong fire: UAE extends condolences to China as death toll rises to 128
item.description: The UAE has extended condolences and solidarity to China after a devastating fire in Hong Kong’s Tai Po district killed at least 94 people and injured dozens

item.title: Sharjah Ring Road to undergo Dh90 million upgrade
item.description: Sharjah Ruler Sheikh Dr Sultan bin Mohammed Al Qasimi has approved a Dh90 million project to upgrade a key stretch of the Sharjah Ring Road

item.title: Winter Night Market: Dubai’s newest night market opens in Deira
item.description: The Winter Night Market has officially opened beside Al Ghurair Centre in Deira, bringing food stalls, performances and family-friendly activities until May 2026

item.title: DTI defends controversial P500 noche buena budget as outrage grows
item.description: DTI Secretary Maria Aldeguer-Roque is under fire after insisting that Filipino families can prepare a noche buena meal for only P500

item.title: ‘P500 noche buena’ remark hits nerve as Filipinos vent anger
item.description: DTI Secretary Maria Cristina Aldeguer-Roque’s claim that a family can prepare noche buena for P500 sparks backlash from Filipinos frustrated by soaring prices

item.title: Ajman sets Guinness World Record with Eid Al Etihad 54 formation
item.description: Ajman breaks a Guinness World Record after 603 vehicles formed the message “EID AL ETIHAD UAE 54”
